method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 在厨房向 Ed 提出要收养 Tommy 和 Leah 的孩子（他们的孙子）。
Hattie 提到有罪判决在两周前下达，Tommy 的量刑听证会就在后天。
facts.anchor: Tommy’s sentencing hearing was the day after tomorrow.

facts.fact: Hattie 告诉 Ed，Leah 已决定把孩子送人收养。
facts.anchor: She’s going to give him up for adoption.

facts.fact: Ed 反对收养，称他们无法逃离这件事，因为这就是他们自己造成的。
facts.anchor: we can’t run from this because it is us. We made this.

facts.fact: Hattie 说即使没有 Ed 的参与，她也要收养这个孩子。
facts.anchor: I’ll do it without you then,

facts.fact: Ed 说自己一直在哀悼、在和儿子告别，随后走出门去。
facts.anchor: I’ve been saying goodbye to my son.

facts.fact: Hattie 在车间发现 Ed 侧躺在运转的桌锯旁，已经死亡。
facts.anchor: Ed lay on his side next to the whirring table saw

facts.fact: Hattie 用手机拨打 911 并对 Ed 做心肺复苏。
facts.anchor: She had her phone with her and dialed 911

facts.fact: Ed 死于数月压力与悲伤累积的心脏病，Hattie 认为那场争吵把它推到了极限。
facts.anchor: heart attack that had been building for months from the stress and sorrow
